nearNote: near variants the stylesheets paint, each in the role its property allows (tokenize.mjs --suggest --near 24): added as palettes, read by a person
templateVarsNote: the template's own T4 theme colours (params/typelist-theme.xml), each in the role the template's palette gives its value; and the variables the JA Content Listing module declares on :root in its own stylesheet (modules/mod_jacontentlisting/assets/style.css, outside any template release): --heading-text-color (section titles and their rules), --color-desc (excerpts), --heading-border-color
varRolesNote: the template's own grey scale and text variables (css/template.css :root, again in .dark-active) paint the JA Content Listing module's stylesheets (modules/mod_jacontentlisting/…, which no template release carries): each takes the role the template uses it in — --gray-700 the excerpts, --gray-900 and --heading-text-color the headings, --meta-color/--gray-500 the meta lines, --gray-100/200 the light fills
contrastNote: text on the overlay cards (.item-style-1: titles and meta laid over the card's photo, an the probe cannot see) is judged by eye, not measured against the page
sideRulesNote: its header search is a closed input whose only paint is a dark magnifier (background-image search.svg; the template swaps to search-light.svg only under its own .dark-active mode): under a dark system the closed input is inverted so the magnifier stays visible; an open or focused input is left alone
